subject.id: globgrph stitch producer, archive carry-forward -- CARRIER: PROPS
subject.declared_domain: The PROP half of the same mechanism: key/value props riding on the nodes this producer reads back out of the snapshot it archives. Covers which copy of a duplicated node wins (and therefore whose props are served) and which prop keys a surviving copy is allowed to carry. Does NOT cover the node population itself (the nodes carrier card) or the edges (the edges carrier card). A prop has no id of its own, which is exactly why this carrier needed a different remedy from the other two.

as_of.graph_vintage: The served projection projection/2026-09-10T01:27:30.508695+00:00/, read at 2026-09-10T01:47:03Z by the seat that filed row NFRA_CLDGRPH-W2-S69, and the local producer run against snapshots/20260909/graph-20260909.tar.gz. NOT RE-READ BY THIS CARD -- the round-7 egress hold; every served number here is read from the record of that read.

methodology.how: Props reach the served graph on their node, so the prop question is decided by WHICH COPY OF A NODE SURVIVES and by WHAT THAT COPY IS ALLOWED TO CARRY. Two producer-side handlers, one for each, both inside _collapse_stitch_copies. The tie-break keeps the object this run emitted, identified by Python object identity taken before the union. The drop pops every key in RETIRED_STITCH_PROPS from every stitch-sourced node that survives, archived or fresh. The producer states why both are needed and the statement is the design: the tie-break decides which copy survives, the drop decides what a surviving copy may carry; only the first would leave the value one iteration-order change away from returning, only the second would leave two copies of every member differing in their props.

coverage.universe: Prop keys on stitch-sourced nodes that the producer has retired and must not serve again.
coverage.denominator: 1 of 1 retired key enumerated (vocabulary), applied to every surviving stitch-sourced node. On the served plane the population moved 1,771 -> 1 -> 0 across round 6: 1,771 stamped at the round's start, 1 surviving the image act (the PORTAL_BUNDLE node), 0 after the producer-side drop, measured over a 27,665-node whole-graph diff whose props delta read exactly one removed key and nothing else.
explicitly_out: EVERY OTHER RETIRED PROP KEY, PRESENT OR FUTURE. RETIRED_STITCH_PROPS is an enumeration, so its coverage is exactly as wide as its list and it lapses SILENTLY when the next key is retired -- the same shape CLAUDE.md names for an enumerated ban list.
props on non-stitch nodes: the collapse never touches a node this producer did not source, deliberately
prop VALUE drift: the remedy removes a key, it does not compare two copies' values, so a fresh and an archived copy differing in a value they both carry is invisible to it

key.identity_space: The pair (node id, prop key). A prop has no key of its own; it is addressed only through its node, and the retired-key remedy addresses it by the literal key STRING.
key.key_expression: n.pop(k) for k in RETIRED_STITCH_PROPS, over every stitch-sourced node that survives the collapse -- derive_stitch.py:456-461 @f3b5f26f77.
key.evidence: infra/aws/globgrph/derive_stitch.py:456-461 @f3b5f26f77. The key string is stable in the sense that matters here -- a literal compared to a literal -- and that stability is precisely what makes the coverage row's enumeration defect a silent one: nothing about a stable key tells you the LIST of keys is complete.

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: A SERVED VALUE THAT NOBODY WRITES ANY MORE, with every writer-side instrument reading clean. This is the measured case, not a hypothetical: the image act retired the fold's writer, the fold printed stamped=0, seven of seven task families were confirmed on the new digest, and the served count stayed at 1. Every instrument pointed at the WRITER said the retirement had worked; only a read of the served value disagreed, and a diff scoped to the stamp would have shown nothing either way because the value was unchanged on both sides.
silent_degrade_paths: THE TIE-BREAK LOSING ITS SIGNAL: the collapse first inferred freshness from retyped_from, the mark the re-type leaves. Once the archived snapshot itself carried canonical names nothing was re-typed, the mark went empty for every node, and the winner fell to dict iteration order. It fell to the archived copy. A signal that goes QUIET degrades silently in a way a signal that goes WRONG does not, and no test of the tie-break's logic could have caught it.

THE ENUMERATION LAPSING: the next prop key retired without an edit to RETIRED_STITCH_PROPS is carried forward exactly as vocabulary was, and the producer will print retired_props_dropped=0 while doing it -- a clean zero indistinguishable from a genuinely clean graph.

A retired key surviving on a node the collapse skips: only nodes with source=portal-stitch are visited (derive_stitch.py:448 @f3b5f26f77), so the same key on a node whose source stamp was lost or never set is never popped.
failure_mode.evidence: NFRA_CLDGRPH-W2-S69 @2f87f07926, five GROUNDED evidence items including the seven-family describe-task-definition read, the derive's own STITCH_INGEST line and the served read; infra/aws/globgrph/derive_stitch.py:411-427 and :447-461 @f3b5f26f77.

verdict.why: Both remedies are in the producer and both are measured working -- the tie-break now rests on an object identity no data field can drift out from under, and the retired key is popped from every surviving stitch-sourced node. What keeps this carrier off SOUND is that its coverage is an ENUMERATION of one key: the mechanism is correct and its population is hand-maintained, so the NEXT retired prop repeats this instance exactly, and the producer's own counter will read 0 while it happens. Usable as evidence that the vocabulary stamp is gone; NOT usable as evidence that no retired prop is being carried forward.
blocking_defects: AN ENUMERATED RETIRED-KEY LIST WITH NO PRODUCER OF ITS OWN (owner 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp): RETIRED_STITCH_PROPS at derive_stitch.py:306 @f3b5f26f77 is maintained by hand, and a prop retired anywhere else in the pipeline does not reach it. Remedy shape: derive the list from the emitter's own current prop vocabulary rather than restating it, or make the producer count and print every prop key that arrives on a carried node and is absent from this cycle's emission -- the shrink, expressed as a number, which is what the edges carrier already does for its edge type.
